title.raw: 新唐書卷三十上 志第二十上 曆六上 Volume 30, Part 1 Treatises 20: Calendar 6, Part 1

sentences.zh: 憲宗即位，司天徐昂上新曆，名曰觀象。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xianzong took the throne, the Astronomical Bureau's Xu Ang presented a new calendar; it was named Guanxiang.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Xianzong came to the throne, Xu Ang of the Astronomical Bureau submitted a new calendar called Observing Phenomena (Guanxiang).

sentences.zh: 起元和二年用之，然無蔀章之數。

translations.literal: It was used beginning in the second year of Yuanhe, yet it had no obscuration-cycle numbers.
translations.idiomatic: It was put into use from the second year of Yuanhe (807), but it lacked obscuration-cycle parameters.

sentences.zh: 至於察斂啟閉之候，循用舊法，測驗不合。

translations.literal: As for the phases of observing gathering-in and opening-and-closing, the old methods were followed, and observation tests did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: For fixing the seasons of gathering-in and opening-and-closing, the calendar still followed older methods, and observational tests failed to match.

sentences.zh: 至穆宗立，以為累世纘緒，必更曆紀，乃詔日官改撰曆術，名曰宣明。

translations.literal: When Emperor Muzong was established, believing that successive generations continuing the line must change the calendar era, he then ordered the solar officials to revise the calendrical methods; it was named Xuanming.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Muzong acceded, holding that a dynasty continuing its line through successive reigns must renew its calendar era, he ordered the court astronomers to draft new calendrical methods, named Illuminating (Xuanming).

sentences.zh: 上元七曜，起赤道虛九度。

translations.literal: At the high origin the seven luminaries begin at nine degrees into Xū on the equator.
translations.idiomatic: At the high origin, the seven luminaries start at 9° of Xū on the celestial equator.

sentences.zh: 其氣朔、發斂、日躔、月離，皆因大衍舊術；

translations.literal: Its qi and new moons, issuing-and-gathering-in, solar pacing, and lunar departure all follow the old Dayan methods;
translations.idiomatic: Its procedures for central qi, new moons, solstitial timing, solar motion, and lunar motion all followed the old Dayan methods;

translations.literal: gnomon-clepsydra and syzygies were slightly increased or decreased;
translations.idiomatic: while gnomon-clepsydra and syzygy parameters were adjusted slightly;

translations.literal: new constants were established to pace the five planets.
translations.idiomatic: and new constants were set to compute the five planets.

translations.literal: The universal divisor is called the cycle constant.
translations.idiomatic: The universal divisor is termed the cycle constant.

translations.literal: The divination solid is called the chapter years.
translations.idiomatic: The divination solid is termed the chapter years.

translations.literal: The stalking method is called the chapter months.
translations.idiomatic: The stalking method is termed the chapter months.

translations.literal: The hanging limit is called the intercalation limit.
translations.idiomatic: The hanging limit is termed the intercalation limit.

translations.literal: The three-origin divination is called the central node.
translations.idiomatic: The three-origin divination is termed the central node.

translations.literal: The four-images divination is called the combined divination.
translations.idiomatic: The four-images divination is termed the combined divination.

translations.literal: The one-image divination is called the image standard.
translations.idiomatic: The one-image divination is termed the image standard.

translations.literal: The divination remainder is called the universal remainder.
translations.idiomatic: The divination remainder is termed the universal remainder.

translations.literal: The line number is called the cycle method.
translations.idiomatic: The line number is termed the cycle method.

translations.literal: Taking the universal cycle method as parts, it is called the ten-day cycle.
translations.idiomatic: The universal cycle method taken as parts is called the ten-day cycle.

translations.literal: Multiplying chapter years by the year, it is called the accumulated universal parts.
translations.idiomatic: Chapter years multiplied by the year-count yield the accumulated universal parts.

translations.literal: The divination at the center of the earth is called the period divination.
translations.idiomatic: The divination at the earth's center is termed the period divination.

translations.literal: The divination at the center of heaven is called the hexagram divination.
translations.idiomatic: The divination at heaven's center is termed the hexagram divination.

sentences.zh: 以貞悔之策減中節，曰辰數。

translations.literal: Subtract the central node from the true-and-false divination, called the chronogram number.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the central node from the true-and-false divination to obtain the chronogram number.

sentences.zh: 以加季月之節，即土用事日。

translations.literal: Add it to the node of the last month of the season; that is the day Earth takes dominion.
translations.idiomatic: Add this to the solar term of the last month of the season, and the result is the day on which Earth takes dominion.

translations.literal: Whenever minor remainders fill the chronogram divisor, that is the chronogram number;
translations.idiomatic: Whenever minor remainders fill the chronogram divisor, they form the chronogram number;

translations.literal: when they fill the quarter-hour divisor, that is quarter-hours.
translations.idiomatic: when they fill the quarter-hour divisor, they form quarter-hours.

translations.literal: The Qian solid is called the image number.
translations.idiomatic: The Qian solid is termed the image number.

translations.literal: The second divisor is three hundred.
Multiply the cycle constant by it; it is called the divided cycle.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the cycle constant by this to obtain the divided cycle.

sentences.zh: 凡步七曜入宿度，皆以刻法為度母。

translations.literal: In all cases pacing the seven luminaries' entry into lodge degrees, all use the quarter-hour divisor as the degree mother.
translations.idiomatic: In computing the seven luminaries' entry into lodge degrees, the quarter-hour divisor serves as the degree mother throughout.

sentences.zh: 凡刻法乘盈縮分，如定氣而一，曰氣中率。

translations.literal: Whenever the quarter-hour divisor multiplies the surplus-deficit parts, taking one per fixed qi, it is called the central rate of qi.
translations.idiomatic: The quarter-hour divisor multiplied by the surplus-deficit parts, divided once per fixed qi, yields the central qi rate.

sentences.zh: 與後氣中率相減，為合差。

translations.literal: Subtracting from the central rate of the following qi, one obtains the combined difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this from the following qi's central rate to obtain the combined difference.

sentences.zh: 以定氣乘合差，併後定氣以除，為中差。

translations.literal: Multiply the combined difference by the fixed qi, combine with the following fixed qi and divide, obtaining the central difference.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the combined difference by the fixed qi, add the following fixed qi as divisor, and divide to obtain the central difference.

translations.literal: Adding and subtracting the qi rate yields the initial and final rates.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the qi rate to obtain the initial and final rates.

sentences.zh: 倍中差，百乘之，以定氣除，為日差。

translations.literal: Double the central difference, multiply by one hundred, divide by the fixed qi, obtaining the daily difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double the central difference, multiply by 100, divide by the fixed qi, and obtain the daily difference.

sentences.zh: 半之，以加、減初、末，各為定率。

translations.literal: Halve it; add and subtract from the initial and final, each becoming the fixed rate.
translations.idiomatic: Halve this value, add or subtract it from the initial and final rates, and each becomes a fixed rate.

sentences.zh: 以日差累加、減之，為每日盈縮分。

translations.literal: Accumulate addition and subtraction by the daily difference to obtain the daily surplus-deficit parts.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate the daily difference by repeated addition and subtraction to obtain each day's surplus-deficit parts.

sentences.zh: 凡百乘氣下先後數，先減、後加常氣，為定氣限數。

translations.literal: In all cases multiply the number before and after qi descent by one hundred; first subtract, then add the regular qi, obtaining the fixed-qi limit number.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the before-and-after qi descent count by 100, first subtract then add the regular qi, and obtain the fixed-qi limit number.

sentences.zh: 乘歲差千四百四十，為秒分。

translations.literal: Multiply the annual discrepancy by 1440 to obtain second-parts.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the annual discrepancy by 1,440 to obtain second-parts.

sentences.zh: 以加中節，因冬至黃道日度，累而裁之，得每定氣初日度。

translations.literal: Add to the central node; proceeding from the winter solstice yellow-path solar degree, accumulate and trim to obtain each fixed-qi initial day's degree.
translations.idiomatic: Add this to the central node; starting from the winter solstice yellow-path solar degree, accumulate and trim to obtain the initial solar degree for each fixed qi.

translations.literal: Entering rotation is called the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Entry into rotation is termed the ephemeris.

sentences.zh: 凡入曆，如曆中已下為進；

translations.literal: Whenever entering the calendar, if at or below the calendar center it is advance;
translations.idiomatic: Whenever entering the ephemeris, if at or below the ephemeris midpoint it counts as advance;

translations.literal: if above, remove it, and that is retreat.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract the excess, and that counts as retreat.

sentences.zh: 凡定朔小餘，秋分後，四分之三已上，進一日。

translations.literal: For fixed new-moon minor remainders, after the autumn equinox, if three-fourths or more, advance one day.
translations.idiomatic: For fixed new-moon minor remainders after the autumn equinox, if three-fourths or more, advance the date by one day.

sentences.zh: 春分後，昏明小餘差春分初日者，五而一，以減四分之三。

translations.literal: After the spring equinox, if twilight minor remainders differ from the spring equinox initial day, take one per five to reduce the three-fourths.
translations.idiomatic: After the spring equinox, when twilight minor remainders differ from the spring equinox initial day, take one-fifth at a time to reduce the three-fourths threshold.

sentences.zh: 定朔小餘如此數已上者，進一日。

translations.literal: If the fixed new-moon minor remainder reaches this number or above, advance one day.
translations.idiomatic: If the fixed new-moon minor remainder reaches this number or higher, advance the date by one day.

translations.literal: If there is a crossing and the initial waning should appear, then not.
translations.idiomatic: If a conjunction occurs and the initial phase of waning should be visible, then do not advance.

sentences.zh: 定弦望小餘，不滿昏明小餘者，退一日。

translations.literal: If fixed first- and full-moon minor remainders do not fill the twilight minor remainder, retreat one day.
translations.idiomatic: If the fixed first- or full-moon minor remainder does not reach the twilight minor remainder, retreat the date by one day.

sentences.zh: 或有交，應見虧初者，亦如之。

translations.literal: If there is a crossing and the initial waning should appear, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: If a conjunction occurs and the initial waning should be visible, the same rule applies.

sentences.zh: 凡正交，以平交入曆朓朒定數，朓減、朒加平交入定氣餘，滿若不足，進退日算，為正交入定氣，不復以交率乘、交數除，及不加減平交入氣朓朒也。

translations.literal: For true crossing, use the waxing-and-waning fixed number of mean crossing entering the calendar; waxing subtracts and waning adds to the mean crossing entering fixed-qi remainder; if full or insufficient, advance or retreat the day count, obtaining true crossing entering fixed qi—no longer multiplying by the crossing rate, dividing by the crossing number, or adding and subtracting mean-crossing entering-qi waxing and waning.
translations.idiomatic: For the true crossing, take the waxing-and-waning fixed number of the mean crossing's entry into the ephemeris; waxing subtracts and waning adds from the mean crossing's entry into the fixed-qi remainder; if the result overflows or falls short, adjust the day count forward or back to obtain the true crossing's entry into fixed qi—without again multiplying by the crossing rate, dividing by the crossing number, or adding and subtracting the mean crossing's waxing-and-waning in qi.

sentences.zh: 凡推月度，以曆分乘夜半定全漏，如刻法而一，為晨分；

translations.literal: In advancing the lunar phase, multiply the calendar parts by the midnight fixed full clepsydra, taking one per quarter-hour divisor, obtaining the dawn parts;
translations.idiomatic: To compute the lunar phase, multiply the ephemeris parts by the fixed full clepsydra at midnight, divide once by the quarter-hour divisor, and obtain the dawn parts;

translations.literal: subtract from the calendar parts to obtain the dusk parts.
translations.idiomatic: subtract this from the ephemeris parts to obtain the dusk parts.

sentences.zh: 又以定朔、弦、望小餘乘曆分，統法除之，以減晨分，餘為前；

translations.literal: Again multiply the fixed new-moon, first-moon, and full-moon minor remainders by the calendar parts, divide by the cycle constant, subtract from the dawn parts; the remainder is before;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the fixed new-, first-, and full-moon minor remainders by the ephemeris parts, divide by the cycle constant, subtract from the dawn parts, and the remainder is the before portion;

translations.literal: if insufficient, reverse the subtraction; the remainder is after.
translations.idiomatic: if insufficient, reverse the subtraction instead, and the remainder is the after portion.

sentences.zh: 乃前加、後減加時月度，為晨昏月度。

translations.literal: Then add before and subtract after from the hour-addition lunar phase, obtaining the dawn-and-dusk lunar phase.
translations.idiomatic: Add the before portion and subtract the after portion from the hour-addition lunar phase to obtain the dawn and dusk lunar phases.

sentences.zh: 以所入加時日度減後曆加時日度，餘加上弦之度及餘，以所入日前減、後加，又以後曆前加、後減，各為定程。

translations.literal: Subtract the following calendar's hour-addition solar degree from the entered hour-addition solar degree; add the remainder to the first-quarter degree and remainder; according to entry subtract before the day and add after, and again for the following calendar add before and subtract after—each becomes the fixed course.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the following ephemeris's hour-addition solar degree from the current entry's hour-addition solar degree, add the remainder to the first-quarter degree and its remainder, subtract before the entry day and add after as required, and likewise add before and subtract after on the following ephemeris—each yielding a fixed course.

sentences.zh: 乃累計距後曆每日曆度及分，以減定程，為盈；

translations.literal: Then accumulate the daily calendar degrees and parts from the distance to the following calendar, subtract from the fixed course—surplus;
translations.idiomatic: Then accumulate the daily ephemeris degrees and parts from the distance to the following ephemeris and subtract from the fixed course; if positive, that is surplus;
if insufficient, reverse the subtraction instead, and that is deficit.

sentences.zh: 以距後曆日數均其差，盈減、縮加每日曆分，為曆定分。

translations.literal: Average the difference over the days to the following calendar; surplus subtracts and deficit adds to the daily calendar parts, obtaining the fixed calendar parts.
translations.idiomatic: Spread the difference evenly over the days to the following ephemeris; subtract surplus and add deficit to each day's ephemeris parts to obtain the fixed ephemeris parts.

sentences.zh: 累以加朔、弦、望晨昏月度，為每日晨昏月度，不復加減屈伸也。

translations.literal: Accumulate to add to the new-moon, first-moon, and full-moon dawn-and-dusk lunar phases, obtaining the daily dawn-and-dusk lunar phases—no longer adding and subtracting waxing and waning.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate these to the new-, first-, and full-moon dawn and dusk lunar phases to obtain each day's dawn and dusk lunar phases, without further adding or subtracting waxing and waning.

translations.literal: The line cycle is called the central cycle.
translations.idiomatic: The line cycle is termed the central cycle.

translations.literal: The image accumulation is called the quarter-hour divisor.
translations.idiomatic: The image accumulation is termed the quarter-hour divisor.

sentences.zh: 以屈伸準盈縮分，求每日所入，曰定衰。

translations.literal: Use waxing-and-waning to align surplus-deficit parts; seek the daily entry, called the fixed decline.
translations.idiomatic: Align surplus-deficit parts by waxing-and-waning, find each day's entry, and term it the fixed decline.

sentences.zh: 五乘之，二十四除之，曰漏差。

translations.literal: Multiply by five, divide by twenty-four; it is called the clepsydra difference.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by five, divide by twenty-four, and obtain the clepsydra difference.

sentences.zh: 屈加、伸減氣初夜半漏，得每日夜半定漏。

translations.literal: Waning adds and waxing subtracts from the initial-qi midnight clepsydra, obtaining the daily midnight fixed clepsydra.
translations.idiomatic: Add waning and subtract waxing from the initial qi midnight clepsydra to obtain each day's fixed midnight clepsydra.

sentences.zh: 刻法通為分，曰昏明小餘。

translations.literal: The quarter-hour divisor converted to parts is called the twilight minor remainder.
translations.idiomatic: The quarter-hour divisor expressed as parts is termed the twilight minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 二十一乘屈伸定數，二十五而一，為黃道屈伸差。

translations.literal: Multiply the waxing-and-waning fixed number by twenty-one, taking one per twenty-five, obtaining the yellow-path waxing-and-waning difference.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the waxing-and-waning fixed number by 21 and divide by 25 to obtain the yellow-path waxing-and-waning difference.

sentences.zh: 乃屈減、伸加氣初去極度分，得每日去極度分。

translations.literal: Then waning subtracts and waxing adds from the initial-qi distance-from-pole parts, obtaining the daily distance-from-pole parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract waning and add waxing from the initial qi's distance-from-pole parts to obtain each day's distance-from-pole parts.

sentences.zh: 以萬二千三百八十六乘黃道屈伸差，萬六千二百七十七而一，為每日度差。

translations.literal: Multiply the yellow-path waxing-and-waning difference by 12,386, taking one per 16,277, obtaining the daily degree difference.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the yellow-path waxing-and-waning difference by 12,386 and divide by 16,277 to obtain the daily degree difference.

sentences.zh: 屈減、伸加氣初距中度分，得每日距中度數。

translations.literal: Waning subtracts and waxing adds from the initial-qi mid-distance parts, obtaining the daily mid-distance number.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract waning and add waxing from the initial qi's mid-distance parts to obtain each day's mid-distance count.

sentences.zh: 凡屈伸準消息於中晷，曰定數；

translations.literal: In all cases waxing-and-waning aligns increase-and-decrease to the midday shadow, called the fixed number;
translations.idiomatic: Waxing-and-waning aligned to increase-and-decrease at the midday gnomon shadow is termed the fixed number;
for clepsydra quarter-hours, the clepsydra difference;

translations.literal: for distance from the pole, waxing-and-waning difference;
translations.idiomatic: for distance from the pole, the waxing-and-waning difference;

translations.literal: Crossing completion is called the completion rate.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing completion is termed the completion rate.

translations.literal: New-moon difference is called crossing new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The new-moon difference is termed the crossing new moon.

translations.literal: Full-moon number is called crossing full moon.
translations.idiomatic: The full-moon number is termed the crossing full moon.

translations.literal: Crossing limit is called the forward standard.
translations.idiomatic: The crossing limit is termed the forward standard.

translations.literal: Full-moon difference is called the rear standard.
translations.idiomatic: The full-moon difference is termed the rear standard.

sentences.zh: 凡月行入四象陰陽度有分者，十乘之，七而一，為度分。

translations.literal: Whenever the moon's motion enters the four-images yin-yang degrees with parts, multiply by ten, take one per seven, obtaining degree-parts.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the moon's motion enters the four-images yin-yang degrees with fractional parts, multiply by 10, divide by 7, and obtain degree-parts.

sentences.zh: 不盡，十五乘之，七除，為大分。

translations.literal: If not exhausted, multiply by fifteen, divide by seven, obtaining major parts.
translations.idiomatic: If a remainder remains, multiply by 15, divide by 7, and obtain major parts.

translations.literal: If still not exhausted, divide again, obtaining minor parts.
translations.idiomatic: If still not exhausted, divide again to obtain minor parts.

sentences.zh: 乃以一象之度九十除之，兼除度差分百一十三、大分七、小分一少，然後以次象除之。

translations.literal: Then divide by the one-image degree of ninety, also dividing the degree-difference parts 113, major parts 7, and minor parts 1 slightly less; then divide by each image in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Then divide by the 90° of one image, also dividing out degree-difference parts 113, major parts 7, and minor parts 1 slightly less, and then divide successively by each image.

sentences.zh: 凡日蝕，以定朔日出入辰刻距午正刻數，約百四十七，為時差。

translations.literal: For solar eclipses, take the fixed new-moon day's entry and exit chronogram quarter-hours' distance from the noon standard quarter-hours, approximate 147, obtaining the time difference.
translations.idiomatic: For solar eclipses, take the fixed new-moon day's chronogram quarter-hours of sunrise and sunset relative to noon standard quarter-hours, reduce by approximately 147, and obtain the time difference.

sentences.zh: 視定朔小餘如半法已下，以減半法，為初率；

translations.literal: Viewing the fixed new-moon minor remainder as at or below the half divisor, subtract from the half divisor, obtaining the initial rate;
translations.idiomatic: If the fixed new-moon minor remainder is at or below half the divisor, subtract it from the half divisor to obtain the initial rate;

sentences.zh: 已上，減去半法，餘為末率。

translations.literal: if above, subtract the half divisor; the remainder is the final rate.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract the half divisor; the remainder is the final rate.

sentences.zh: 以乘時差，如刻法而一，初率以減，末率倍之，以加定朔小餘，為蝕定餘。

translations.literal: Multiply by the time difference, taking one per quarter-hour divisor; the initial rate subtracts, the final rate doubles and adds to the fixed new-moon minor remainder, obtaining the eclipse fixed remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the time difference and divide once by the quarter-hour divisor; subtract with the initial rate, double the final rate and add to the fixed new-moon minor remainder, and obtain the eclipse fixed remainder.

sentences.zh: 月蝕，以定望小餘為蝕定餘。

translations.literal: For lunar eclipses, take the fixed full-moon minor remainder as the eclipse fixed remainder.
translations.idiomatic: For lunar eclipses, the fixed full-moon minor remainder serves as the eclipse fixed remainder.

sentences.zh: 凡日蝕，有氣差，有刻差，有加差。

translations.literal: For solar eclipses there are qi difference, quarter-hour difference, and additive difference.
translations.idiomatic: Solar eclipses involve qi difference, quarter-hour difference, and additive difference.

sentences.zh: 二至之初，氣差二千三百五十。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the two solstices, the qi difference is 2350.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the two solstices, the qi difference is 2,350.

sentences.zh: 距二至前後，每日損二十六，至二分而空。

translations.literal: From before and after the two solstices, daily decrease 26, until the two equinoxes and empty.
translations.idiomatic: Moving away from the solstices before and after, decrease by 26 each day until the equinoxes, when it reaches zero.

sentences.zh: 以日出沒辰刻距午正刻數，約其朔日氣差，以乘食甚距午正刻數。

translations.literal: Take the sunrise and sunset chronogram quarter-hours' distance from noon standard quarter-hours, approximate the new-moon day's qi difference, multiply by the greatest eclipse's distance from noon standard quarter-hours.
translations.idiomatic: Take the chronogram quarter-hours of sunrise and sunset relative to noon, approximate the new-moon day's qi difference, and multiply by the greatest eclipse's distance from noon standard quarter-hours.

translations.literal: Subtract the product from the qi difference, obtaining the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the product from the qi difference to obtain the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 春分後，陰曆加之，陽曆減之；

translations.literal: After the spring equinox, add for yin calendar and subtract for yang calendar;
translations.idiomatic: After the spring equinox, add for yin months and subtract for yang months;

sentences.zh: 秋分後，陰曆減之，陽曆加之。

translations.literal: after the autumn equinox, subtract for yin calendar and add for yang calendar.
translations.idiomatic: after the autumn equinox, subtract for yin months and add for yang months.

translations.literal: On the initial day of the two solstices, there is no quarter-hour difference.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of each solstice, there is no quarter-hour difference.

sentences.zh: 自後每日益差分二、小分十。

translations.literal: Thereafter daily increase difference parts 2, minor parts 10.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the difference increases each day by 2 parts and 10 minor parts.

sentences.zh: 起立春至立夏，起立秋至立冬，皆以九十四分有半為刻差。

translations.literal: From Beginning of Spring to Beginning of Summer, and from Beginning of Autumn to Beginning of Winter, all use 94 and a half parts as the quarter-hour difference.
translations.idiomatic: From Beginning of Spring to Beginning of Summer, and from Beginning of Autumn to Beginning of Winter, the quarter-hour difference is set at 94½ parts.

sentences.zh: 自後日損差分二、小分十，至二至之初損盡。

translations.literal: Thereafter daily decrease difference parts 2, minor parts 10, until exhausted at the beginning of the two solstices.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter decrease the difference by 2 parts and 10 minor parts each day until it is exhausted at the next solstice.

sentences.zh: 以朔日刻差乘食甚距午正刻數，為刻差定數。

translations.literal: Take the new-moon day's quarter-hour difference, multiply by the greatest eclipse's distance from noon standard quarter-hours, obtaining the quarter-hour difference fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the new-moon day's quarter-hour difference by the greatest eclipse's distance from noon standard quarter-hours to obtain the fixed quarter-hour difference.

sentences.zh: 冬至後食甚在午正前，夏至後食甚在午正後，陰曆以減，陽曆以加；

translations.literal: After winter solstice, when greatest eclipse is before noon standard, and after summer solstice when greatest eclipse is after noon standard: subtract for yin months, add for yang months;
translations.idiomatic: After the winter solstice, if greatest eclipse falls before noon standard, and after the summer solstice if it falls after noon standard, subtract for yin months and add for yang months;

sentences.zh: 冬至後食甚在午正後，夏至後食甚在午正前，陰曆以加，陽曆以減。

translations.literal: After winter solstice when greatest eclipse is after noon standard, and after summer solstice when greatest eclipse is before noon standard: add for yin months, subtract for yang months.
translations.idiomatic: After the winter solstice, if greatest eclipse falls after noon standard, and after the summer solstice if it falls before noon standard, add for yin months and subtract for yang months.

sentences.zh: 又立冬初日後，每氣增差十七。

translations.literal: Furthermore, after the first day of Start of Winter, increase the difference by seventeen for each qi.
translations.idiomatic: After the first day of Start of Winter, increase the difference by 17 for each qi.

translations.literal: By the first day of winter solstice, it reaches fifty-one.
translations.idiomatic: By the first day of the winter solstice, it reaches 51.

sentences.zh: 自後，每氣損十七，終于大寒，損盡。

translations.literal: Thereafter, decrease by seventeen for each qi until Great Cold, when it is fully exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter decrease by 17 for each qi until Great Cold, when it is fully exhausted.

sentences.zh: 若蝕甚在午正後，則每刻累益其差，陰曆以減，陽曆以加。

translations.literal: If greatest eclipse falls after noon standard, then for each quarter-hour cumulatively increase the difference; subtract for yin months, add for yang months.
translations.idiomatic: If greatest eclipse falls after noon standard, cumulatively increase the difference for each quarter-hour; subtract for yin months and add for yang months.

sentences.zh: 應加減差，同名相從，異名相銷，各為蝕差。

translations.literal: For the differences to be added or subtracted, combine those of the same sign and cancel those of opposite sign; each result is an eclipse correction.
translations.idiomatic: For the applicable add-subtract differences, combine matching signs and cancel opposite signs; each result is an eclipse correction.

translations.literal: Add or subtract from the distance from conjunction to obtain the fixed fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract from the distance from conjunction to obtain the fixed fraction.

sentences.zh: 月在陰曆，不足減，反減蝕差。

translations.literal: When the moon is in a yin month, if subtraction is insufficient, subtract the eclipse correction in reverse.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon is in a yin month, if subtraction is insufficient, subtract the eclipse correction in reverse.

sentences.zh: 交前減之，餘為陽曆交後定分；

translations.literal: Subtract before conjunction; the remainder is the yang-month fixed fraction after conjunction;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract before conjunction; the remainder is the yang-month fixed fraction after conjunction;

sentences.zh: 交後減之，餘為陽曆交前定分：皆不蝕。

translations.literal: subtract after conjunction; the remainder is the yang-month fixed fraction before conjunction: in neither case is there an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: subtract after conjunction; the remainder is the yang-month fixed fraction before conjunction: in neither case is there an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 陽曆不足減，亦反減蝕差。

translations.literal: When in a yang month subtraction is insufficient, likewise subtract the eclipse correction in reverse.
translations.idiomatic: When in a yang month subtraction is insufficient, likewise subtract the eclipse correction in reverse.

sentences.zh: 交前減之，餘為陰曆交後定分；

translations.literal: Subtract before conjunction; the remainder is the yin-month fixed fraction after conjunction;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract before conjunction; the remainder is the yin-month fixed fraction after conjunction;

sentences.zh: 交後減之，餘為陰曆交前定分：皆蝕。

translations.literal: subtract after conjunction; the remainder is the yin-month fixed fraction before conjunction: in both cases there is an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: subtract after conjunction; the remainder is the yin-month fixed fraction before conjunction: in both cases there is an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 凡去交定分，如陽曆蝕限已下，為陽曆蝕。

translations.literal: In general, for the fixed distance from conjunction: if at or below the yang-month eclipse limit, it is a yang-month eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In general, for the fixed distance from conjunction, if it is at or below the yang-month eclipse limit, the eclipse is a yang-month eclipse.

translations.literal: Reduce by the yang-month fixed divisor to obtain the eclipse magnitude.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce by the yang-month fixed divisor to obtain the eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: 已上者，以陽曆蝕限減之，餘為陰曆蝕。

translations.literal: If above, subtract the yang-month eclipse limit; the remainder is a yin-month eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If above, subtract the yang-month eclipse limit; the remainder is a yin-month eclipse.

sentences.zh: 以陰曆定法約之，以減十五，餘為蝕分。

translations.literal: Reduce by the yin-month fixed divisor, subtract from fifteen; the remainder is the eclipse magnitude.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce by the yin-month fixed divisor, subtract from 15, and the remainder is the eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: 凡月蝕去交分，二千一百四十七已下，皆既。

translations.literal: For lunar eclipses, when the distance from conjunction is two thousand one hundred forty-seven or less, all are total.
translations.idiomatic: For lunar eclipses, when the distance from conjunction is 2,147 or less, the eclipse is total in every case.

sentences.zh: 已上者，以減後準，餘如定法五百六約，為蝕分。

translations.literal: If above, subtract the posterior criterion; reduce the remainder by fixed divisor five hundred six to obtain the eclipse magnitude.
translations.idiomatic: If above, subtract the posterior criterion; divide the remainder by fixed divisor 506 to obtain the eclipse magnitude.

translations.literal: For total lunar eclipses, use twenty provisional quarter-hours throughout.
translations.idiomatic: For total lunar eclipses, use 20 provisional quarter-hours throughout.

sentences.zh: 如去交分千四百三十五已下，因增半刻。

translations.literal: If the distance from conjunction is one thousand four hundred thirty-five or less, add half a quarter-hour additionally.
translations.idiomatic: If the distance from conjunction is 1,435 or less, add an additional half quarter-hour.

sentences.zh: 七百一十二已下，又增半刻。

translations.literal: If seven hundred twelve or less, add another half quarter-hour.
translations.idiomatic: If it is 712 or less, add another half quarter-hour.

sentences.zh: 凡日月帶蝕出沒，各以定法通蝕分，半定用刻約之，以乘見刻。

translations.literal: For solar and lunar grazing eclipses at emergence and setting, convert the eclipse magnitude through the fixed divisor for each, reduce by half the fixed applicable quarter-hours, and multiply by the visible quarter-hours.
translations.idiomatic: For solar and lunar grazing eclipses at rising and setting, convert each eclipse magnitude through the fixed divisor, divide by half the fixed applicable quarter-hours, and multiply by the visible quarter-hours.

sentences.zh: 多於半定用刻，出為進，沒為退。

translations.literal: If greater than half the fixed applicable quarter-hours, emergence counts as advance and setting as retreat.
translations.idiomatic: If the result exceeds half the fixed applicable quarter-hours, emergence counts as advance and setting as retreat.

sentences.zh: 少於半定用刻，出為退，沒為進。

translations.literal: If less than half the fixed applicable quarter-hours, emergence counts as retreat and setting as advance.
translations.idiomatic: If it is less than half the fixed applicable quarter-hours, emergence counts as retreat and setting as advance.

sentences.zh: 各如定法而一，為見蝕之大分。

translations.literal: Reduce each once per fixed divisor to obtain the major fraction of visible eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Divide each once by the fixed divisor to obtain the major fraction of visible eclipse.

translations.literal: For new moon in daylight and full moon at night, both use visible quarter-hours.
translations.idiomatic: For new moons in daylight and full moons at night, both use visible quarter-hours.

sentences.zh: 其九服蝕差，則不復考詳。

translations.literal: For eclipse corrections in the nine domains, no further detailed examination is made.
translations.idiomatic: For eclipse corrections in the nine domains, no further detailed examination is made.

translations.literal: The five planets' terminal rate is called the cycle rate.
translations.idiomatic: The five planets' terminal rate is termed the cycle rate.

translations.literal: Add middle hiding to mean conjunction to obtain mean appearance.
translations.idiomatic: Add middle hiding to mean conjunction to obtain mean appearance.

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury, add evening visibility to get morning;
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury, add evening visibility to obtain morning visibility;
add morning visibility to obtain evening visibility.

sentences.zh: 又以變差乘年，滿象數去之；

translations.literal: Also multiply the mutation difference by the year-count and remove what fills the image number;
translations.idiomatic: Also multiply the mutation difference by the year-count and cast out full image numbers;

translations.literal: the remainder is the mutation crossing.
translations.idiomatic: the remainder is the mutation crossing.

sentences.zh: 三百約為分，統法而一，以減平見。

translations.literal: Reduce to parts by three hundred, divide once by the cycle constant, and subtract from mean appearance.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce to parts by 300, divide once by the cycle constant, and subtract from mean appearance.

sentences.zh: 三十六乘平見秒，十二乘變交秒，同以三千六百為母。

translations.literal: Multiply mean appearance seconds by thirty-six and mutation crossing seconds by twelve, with three thousand six hundred as the common denominator.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply mean appearance seconds by 36 and mutation crossing seconds by 12, with 3,600 as the common denominator.

sentences.zh: 餘如交率已下，星在陽曆；

translations.literal: If the remainder is at or below the crossing rate, the star is in the yang half;
translations.idiomatic: If the remainder is at or below the crossing rate, the planet is in the yang half;

translations.literal: if above, discard it; the remainder is entry into the yin half.
translations.idiomatic: if above, discard it; the remainder is entry into the yin half.

sentences.zh: 各以變策除，為變數，命初變算外；

translations.literal: Divide each by the mutation divination to obtain the mutation count, counting outside the initial mutation tally;
translations.idiomatic: Divide each by the mutation divination to obtain the mutation count, counting from outside the initial mutation tally;

sentences.zh: 不盡為入其變度數及餘。

translations.literal: the remainder is entry into its mutation degree-count and remainder.
translations.idiomatic: the remainder is entry into its mutation degree-count and remainder.

sentences.zh: 自此百約餘分，母同刻法。

translations.literal: From this point, reduce the remainder parts by one hundred; the denominator matches the quarter-hour divisor.
translations.idiomatic: From this point, reduce the remainder parts by 100; the denominator matches the quarter-hour divisor.

sentences.zh: 以所入變下數，加減平見，為常見。

translations.literal: Add or subtract from mean appearance by the number below for the mutation entered, obtaining regular appearance.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract from mean appearance by the number below for the mutation entered to obtain regular appearance.

sentences.zh: 金星晨見，先計自夕見，盡夕退，應加減先後差。

translations.literal: For Venus morning appearance, first compute from evening appearance through all evening retrograde, applying the prior-posterior differences to be added or subtracted.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus morning appearance, first compute from evening appearance through all evening retrograde, applying the prior-posterior differences to be added or subtracted.

translations.literal: Where signs match, combine; where they differ, cancel.
translations.idiomatic: Where signs match, combine; where they differ, cancel.

sentences.zh: 與晨常見加減差，異名相銷，同名相從。

translations.literal: With the morning regular appearance add-subtract difference, cancel opposite signs and combine matching signs.
translations.idiomatic: With the morning regular appearance add-subtract difference, cancel opposite signs and combine matching signs.

translations.literal: Accordingly add or subtract from morning mean appearance to obtain regular appearance.
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly add or subtract from morning mean appearance to obtain regular appearance.

sentences.zh: 凡常見計入定氣，求先後定數，各以差率乘之，差數而一，為定差。

translations.literal: In general, set regular appearance against fixed qi, seek the prior-posterior fixed numbers, multiply each by the difference rate and divide once by the difference number, obtaining the fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: In general, set regular appearance against fixed qi, find the prior-posterior fixed numbers, multiply each by the difference rate and divide once by the difference number, and obtain the fixed difference.

sentences.zh: 晨見先減、後加，夕見先加、後減常見，為定見。

translations.literal: For morning appearance subtract first and add later; for evening appearance add first and subtract later from regular appearance, obtaining fixed appearance.
translations.idiomatic: For morning appearance subtract first and add later; for evening appearance add first and subtract later from regular appearance to obtain fixed appearance.

sentences.zh: 以常見與定見加減數，加減平見入變度數及餘秒，為定見初變所入。

translations.literal: Use the add-subtract amounts of regular appearance and fixed appearance to add or subtract from mean appearance's entered mutation degree-count and remainder seconds, obtaining the initial mutation entered at fixed appearance.
translations.idiomatic: Use the add-subtract amounts of regular appearance and fixed appearance to adjust mean appearance's entered mutation degree-count and remainder seconds, obtaining the initial mutation entered at fixed appearance.

sentences.zh: 以所行度順加、退減之，即次變所入。

translations.literal: Add for direct motion and subtract for retrograde by the degrees traveled; that is the next mutation entered.
translations.idiomatic: Add for direct motion and subtract for retrograde by the degrees traveled; that is the next mutation entered.

sentences.zh: 各以所入變下差數加減日度變率。

translations.literal: For each, add or subtract the difference number below the mutation entered to the daily-degree phase rate.
translations.idiomatic: For each, add or subtract the difference number below the mutation entered to the daily-degree phase rate.

sentences.zh: 其水星常見與定見加減數，同名相從，異名相銷，反其加減。

translations.literal: For Mercury, the add-subtract amounts of regular appearance and fixed appearance: combine matching signs, cancel opposite signs, and reverse the additions and subtractions.
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury, the add-subtract amounts of regular appearance and fixed appearance combine matching signs, cancel opposite signs, and reverse the additions and subtractions.

sentences.zh: 夕見差加疾行日率者，倍其差，加度率。

translations.literal: When evening appearance's difference adds to the swift-motion day rate, double the difference and add to the degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: When evening appearance's difference adds to the swift-motion day rate, double the difference and add to the degree rate.

sentences.zh: 又分其差，以加遲留日率。

translations.literal: Also divide the difference and add to the slow-and-stationary day rate.
translations.idiomatic: Also divide the difference and add to the slow-and-stationary day rate.

sentences.zh: 晨見亦分其差，以加遲留日率，以所差之數，加疾行日率，亦倍其差，加疾行度率。

translations.literal: For morning appearance likewise divide the difference and add to the slow-and-stationary day rate; add the difference amount to the swift-motion day rate, likewise double the difference, and add to the swift-motion degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: For morning appearance likewise divide the difference and add to the slow-and-stationary day rate; add the difference amount to the swift-motion day rate, double the difference, and add to the swift-motion degree rate.

sentences.zh: 夕見差減疾行日率者，倍其差，減度率。

translations.literal: When evening appearance's difference subtracts from the swift-motion day rate, double the difference and subtract from the degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: When evening appearance's difference subtracts from the swift-motion day rate, double the difference and subtract from the degree rate.

sentences.zh: 又以其差減留日，不足減，侵減遲日。

translations.literal: Also subtract the difference from station days; if insufficient, encroach and subtract from slow days.
translations.idiomatic: Also subtract the difference from station days; if insufficient, encroach and subtract from slow days.

sentences.zh: 晨見差減留日，不足減者，侵減遲日，亦以其差減疾行日率，倍其差，以減度率。

translations.literal: When morning appearance's difference subtracts from station days, if insufficient encroach and subtract from slow days; also subtract the difference from the swift-motion day rate, double the difference, and subtract from the degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: When morning appearance's difference subtracts from station days, if insufficient encroach and subtract from slow days; also subtract the difference from the swift-motion day rate, double the difference, and subtract from the degree rate.

sentences.zh: 前變初日與後變末日先後數，同名相銷，異名相從，為先後定數。

translations.literal: The prior-posterior numbers of the first day of the prior mutation and the last day of the posterior mutation: cancel matching signs, combine opposite signs, obtaining the prior-posterior fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: The prior-posterior numbers of the first day of the prior mutation and the last day of the posterior mutation cancel matching signs and combine opposite signs to obtain the prior-posterior fixed number.

sentences.zh: 各以差率乘之，差數而一，為日差。

translations.literal: Multiply each by the difference rate and divide once by the difference number, obtaining the day difference.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply each by the difference rate and divide once by the difference number to obtain the day difference.

translations.literal: Venus uses the posterior mutation's difference rate and difference number.
translations.idiomatic: Venus uses the posterior mutation's difference rate and difference number.

sentences.zh: 以先後定數減之，為度差。

translations.literal: Subtract the prior-posterior fixed number to obtain the degree difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the prior-posterior fixed number to obtain the degree difference.

sentences.zh: 金星夕伏，以日差減先後定數，為度差。

translations.literal: For Venus evening hiding, subtract the day difference from the prior-posterior fixed number to obtain the degree difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus evening hiding, subtract the day difference from the prior-posterior fixed number to obtain the degree difference.

sentences.zh: 晨伏以先後定數加日差，為度差。

translations.literal: For morning hiding, add the day difference to the prior-posterior fixed number to obtain the degree difference.
translations.idiomatic: For morning hiding, add the day difference to the prior-posterior fixed number to obtain the degree difference.

sentences.zh: 水星夕伏，以先後定數為日差。

translations.literal: For Mercury evening hiding, take the prior-posterior fixed number as the day difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Mercury evening hiding, take the prior-posterior fixed number as the day difference.

translations.literal: Double it to obtain the degree difference.
translations.idiomatic: Double it to obtain the degree difference.

sentences.zh: 乃以日度差，積盈者以減、積縮者以加末變日度率。

translations.literal: Then with the day-degree difference: where surplus has accumulated subtract, where deficit has accumulated add to the final mutation's daily-degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: Then with the day-degree difference, subtract where surplus has accumulated and add where deficit has accumulated to the final mutation's daily-degree rate.

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury morning hiding, reverse the application of the difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury morning hiding, reverse the application of the difference.

sentences.zh: 又倍退行差，差率乘之，差數而一，為日差。

translations.literal: Also double the retrograde difference, multiply by the difference rate, divide once by the difference number, obtaining the day difference.
translations.idiomatic: Also double the retrograde difference, multiply by the difference rate, divide once by the difference number, and obtain the day difference.

translations.literal: Subtract the retrograde difference to obtain the degree difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the retrograde difference to obtain the degree difference.

sentences.zh: 金星夕伏，以日差減退差，為度差。

translations.literal: For Venus evening hiding, subtract the retrograde difference from the day difference to obtain the degree difference.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus evening hiding, subtract the retrograde difference from the day difference to obtain the degree difference.

sentences.zh: 晨伏以退差加日差，為度差。

translations.literal: For morning hiding, add the retrograde difference to the day difference to obtain the degree difference.
translations.idiomatic: For morning hiding, add the retrograde difference to the day difference to obtain the degree difference.

sentences.zh: 以退行日度差應加者減末變日度率。

translations.literal: Where the retrograde day-degree difference should add, subtract from the final mutation's daily-degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: Where the retrograde day-degree difference should add, subtract from the final mutation's daily-degree rate.

translations.literal: For morning hiding, reverse the application of the difference.
translations.idiomatic: For morning hiding, reverse the application of the difference.

sentences.zh: 各加減變訖，為日度定率。

translations.literal: After all add-subtract adjustments to the phase rates, the result is the fixed daily-degree rate.
translations.idiomatic: After all add-subtract adjustments to the phase rates, the result is the fixed daily-degree rate.

translations.literal: All else likewise follows the Dayan Calendar methods.
translations.idiomatic: All else likewise follows the Dayan Calendar methods.

sentences.zh: 其分秒不同，則各據本曆母法云。

translations.literal: Where parts and seconds differ, each follows its own calendar's base divisors.
translations.idiomatic: Where parts and seconds differ, each follows its own calendar's base divisors.

translations.literal: Beginning in the second year of Changqing, the Illuminating Calendar was used.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning in the second year of Changqing, the Illuminating Calendar was used.

sentences.zh: 自敬宗至于僖宗，皆遵用之。

translations.literal: From Emperor Jingzong through Emperor Xizong, all adhered to it.
translations.idiomatic: From Emperor Jingzong through Emperor Xizong, all adhered to it.

sentences.zh: 雖朝廷多故，不暇討論，然大衍曆後，法制簡易，合望密近，無能出其右者。

translations.literal: Though the court faced many troubles and lacked leisure for revision, among calendars after the Dayan it was the simplest in method and the closest in matching conjunctions and full moons—none could surpass it.
translations.idiomatic: Though the court faced many troubles and lacked leisure for revision, among calendars after the Dayan it was the simplest in method and the closest in matching conjunctions and full moons, and none could surpass it.

translations.literal: This continued until the first year of Jingfu.
translations.idiomatic: This continued until the first year of Jingfu.

translations.literal: The Observing Phenomena Calendar is no longer transmitted among the current officials.
translations.idiomatic: The Observing Phenomena Calendar is no longer transmitted among the current officials.

sentences.zh: 長慶宣明曆演紀上元甲子，至長慶二年壬寅，積七百七萬一百三十八算外。

translations.literal: In computing the evolving era of the Changqing Illuminating Calendar, the high origin is jiazi; reckoned to the second year of Changqing, year renyin, the accumulated count is seven million seventy thousand one hundred thirty-eight beyond the tally.
translations.idiomatic: In computing the evolving era of the Changqing Illuminating Calendar, the high origin falls in the year jiazi; reckoned to the second year of Changqing (renyin), the accumulated count is 7,070,138 beyond the tally.

translations.literal: Illuminating cycle constant: eight thousand four hundred.

sentences.zh: 章歲三百六萬八千五十五。

translations.literal: Chapter years: three million sixty-eight thousand fifty-five.

sentences.zh: 章月二十四萬八千五十七。

translations.literal: Chapter months: two hundred forty-eight thousand fifty-seven.

sentences.zh: 章閏九萬一千三百七十一。

translations.literal: Intercalation chapter: ninety-one thousand three hundred seventy-one.

sentences.zh: 閏限二十四萬四百四十三，秒六。

translations.literal: Intercalation limit: two hundred forty thousand four hundred forty-three, six parts.

sentences.zh: 中節十五，餘千八百三十五，秒五。

translations.literal: Central node: fifteen, remainder one thousand eight hundred thirty-five, five parts.

sentences.zh: 合策二十九，餘四千四百五十七。

translations.literal: Combined divination: twenty-nine, remainder four thousand four hundred fifty-seven.

sentences.zh: 象準七，餘三千二百一十四少。

translations.literal: Image standard: seven, remainder three thousand two hundred fourteen and slightly less.
translations.idiomatic: Image standard: 7, remainder 3,214 and slightly less.

sentences.zh: 中盈分三千六百七十一，秒二。

translations.literal: Central-qi surplus fraction: three thousand six hundred seventy-one, two parts.

sentences.zh: 朔虛分三千九百四十三。

translations.literal: Synodic void fraction: three thousand nine hundred forty-three.
Ten-day cycle: five hundred four thousand.

sentences.zh: 候數五，餘六百一十一，秒七。

translations.literal: Period number: five, remainder six hundred eleven, seven parts.

sentences.zh: 卦位六，餘七百三十四，秒二。

translations.literal: Hexagram position: six, remainder seven hundred thirty-four, two parts.

sentences.zh: 辰數十二，餘千四百六十八，秒四。

translations.literal: Chronogram count: twelve, remainder one thousand four hundred sixty-eight, four parts.

sentences.zh: 象數九億二千四十四萬六千一百九十九。

translations.literal: Image number: nine hundred twenty million four hundred forty-six thousand one hundred ninety-nine.
Circuit of heaven: three hundred sixty-five degrees.

sentences.zh: 虛分二千一百五十三，秒二百九十九。

translations.literal: Void fraction: two thousand one hundred fifty-three, two hundred ninety-nine parts.

sentences.zh: 歲差二萬九千六百九十九。
